messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery"
set: ["tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "be sure caregivers know ahead of time", "tell doctor if planning surgery", "tell your surgeon before any operation", "tell surgeon and dentist about use", "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to", "surgery", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "tell your eye surgeon you take or have taken it", "needing to urinate often or urgently", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery or dental procedure", "do not stop using carvedilol before surgery unless your surgeon tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol",
    "tell your surgeon before any operation",
    "tell surgeon and dentist about use",
    "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it",
    "do not stop taking before surgery unless surgeon tells you to",
    "do not stop using carvedilol before surgery unless your surgeon tells you to"
  ],
  "alias": "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery"
}
